user.title: Jira Filters Setup
user.description: Configure your Jira connection details. You'll need your Jira Cloud URL, email address, and API token.

data.name: Connection Name (optional - will use URL basename if empty)

filter.title: Add Jira Filter
filter.description:
Add a Jira filter to monitor. You can find the Filter ID in the URL when viewing a saved filter in Jira.

If you don't provide a filter name, the system will automatically use the name from Jira.

data.filter_name: Filter Name (optional - will use Jira name if empty)

add_more.title: Add More Filters
add_more.description: Would you like to add another filter? You can always add more later through the integration options.
